name: Cavemen
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator of all things, forming man uniquely in His own image from the dust of the ground and breathing life into him, as seen in Genesis 1 and 2. While the Bible does not specifically describe 'cavemen' as a distinct group, it does record instances of people dwelling in caves, such as Lot and his daughters seeking refuge, and the Israelites making dens and caves for protection during times of oppression. These passages underscore both God's creative authority over humanity and the practical realities of human life in a fallen world.
